elements_selected.content: Implement `zetl reason why-not <LITERAL>` per CON-015. Explains why a literal is NOT provable by analyzing: which rules could prove it, what body literals are missing or failed, and which defeaters are blocking it. Each missing/failed literal includes the document(s) that would need to assert it. Two blocker types: 'failed_body' (missing precondition) and 'defeated' (blocked by a defeater). Exit codes: 0 explanation generated, 1 literal not in theory.
